jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(K) inventory: White River Unified District, a unified union district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member towns: Bethel, Royalton). Operates PK-12.
White River Valley Supervisory Union (official site).

board.org_name: White River Unified District School Board
board.post_note: White River Unified District (unified union, 16 V.S.A. section 729): six directors, residency allocated Bethel 3 / Royalton 3, elected district-wide with comingled ballots (modified at-large).

sources.note: White River Unified District 2025 annual meeting warning (official, in the draft minutes): Art. 13 warns one 3-year seat per town per year; both towns' voters are warned to the same polls and "the ballots will be co-mingled and publicly counted" -- modified at-large in practice. The current roster is the district's official building-project site (spring 2026, post-dating the March 2026 meeting): Pejouhy (Chair), Daniel (Vice Chair), Hinman (Clerk), Ainsworth, Dumais, Sullivan. NO official source fetched publishes term ends -- none are coded; Daniel (Bethel) and Dumais (Royalton) stood for the two warned 3-year seats at the March 3, 2025 meeting per the draft minutes (election year in this note only). Andrew Jones (Chair) and Rodney Rainville (Vice Chair) sign the Jan. 2025 warning and are recorded in the March 3, 2025 draft minutes as "not returning to the board" -- ended 2025. Sullivan's town is established by no fetched official document and is not stated.
